authority.user_instruction: Continue selecting and shipping bounded evidence-driven checkpoints without routine approval while preserving the thesis, external-source gates, and security boundaries.

scope.objective: Preserve fresh decision evidence under stale project-evidence flooding in development and untouched held-out splits without changing the bounded agent, action set, executor, approval boundary, freshness duration, or runtime authority.
forbidden_work: Connect to or mutate real operational infrastructure
Add, remove, or broaden an executor action or capability
Give the agent or model credentials, approval material, idempotency authority, or execution access
Weaken proposal hashing, expiry, idempotency, replay protection, preconditions, postconditions, audit logging, evidence-kind boundaries, or the one-hour freshness rule
Add a package dependency, model, external service, secret, account, download, or externally controlled asset
Change repository visibility, access, ownership, or the deterministic default
Use the held-out stale-evidence variant as implementation feedback
Rewrite or discard v0.0.8 or unfavorable evidence
reversible_actions: Freeze project-authored development and held-out stale-evidence variants and exact retrieval and behavior expectations
Add a fail-closed independent stale-evidence validator and separate metrics
Factor the existing one-hour freshness rule into shared deterministic code
Compare the released evidence-priority retriever with one freshness-priority lexical candidate
Select only a measured Pareto improvement
Record immutable deterministic evaluation artifacts and release receipts
Commit and publish a verified checkpoint
stop_conditions: New action, dependency, external asset, spend, paid service, secret, account, or download required

The final pre-implementation test run retains exactly three expected failures: both stale-evidence variants request evidence instead of their frozen action, and aggregate disposition is remediate.

retained_failures: A combined compile-and-focused-test command was launched from the tests directory, so compileall reported that src, scripts, and tests were not present there while returning success; compilation was rerun from the repository root and passed before candidate completion.
